messages:
Rae: Customer hit a weird one: Ruby quickstart prints 200 and exits but the sample UI never renders streamed tokens.
Ibrahim: 200 but no chunks? which endpoint were they hitting?
Rae: /v1/streams, same key used for curl works (chunks), but Ruby sample gets final body all at once or nothing.
Casey (devex): Any billing state? this smells like the billing gating we saw.
Marta (support): User org created via invite; console shows "trial pending" and a subtle banner. They assumed 200 meant success and kept going.
BillingBot: Reminder: streaming is disabled for billing_inactive orgs; responses may be returned non-chunked to conserve resources. See docs.
Tess (sdk): Ruby Net::HTTP stream handling expects chunked encoding to yield data. If server returns a short JSON body instead we treat it as completed response. SDK should detect that and raise a BillingInactiveError.
Ibrahim: We also saw HTML billing pages for SA keys in other threads. We need consistent JSON errors for API consumers, not HTML.
Casey (devex): Proposed changes: 1) backend: always return structured JSON + 402 status for billing-inactive API calls (no HTML), or for stream endpoints return an early error chunk with billing code; 2) SDKs: add heuristic to detect non-chunked short responses for stream requests and surface clear billing error; 3) quickstarts: add preflight /workspaces/me check to warn users before running sample; 4) docs: add troubleshooting snippet "200 but no streaming tokens".
Tess (sdk): I'll add a small Ruby SDK patch: if request type == stream and headers don't include Transfer-Encoding: chunked and body size < 1KB -> raise BillingInactiveError with link to console.
Marta (support): I'll inform the customer and give workaround: activate trial or add billing method, then re-create service keys.
Ibrahim: Also add telemetry event first_call_stream_no_chunks so we can measure sign-up churn impact.
Casey (devex): Landing plan: backend change this sprint, SDK patch next release, quickstart preflight and docs update in the same PR. I'll coordinate.
Rae: Thanks — adding the user's logs to a Sentry ticket now and will paste link here. :thumbsup:
